S0288.reason: Microtubules are essential for chromosome segregation during meiosis, so reduced MAP function would most affect meiosis.

S0313.reason: Rho(D) immune globulin prevents the mother from forming anti-D antibodies, which could harm future Rh-positive fetuses.

S1029.reason: Strict liability for wild animals covers all injuries caused by the animal, regardless of typicality or victim vulnerability.
